body: Plane geometry remains a significant challenge in AI, requiring the integration of visual perception and mathematical reasoning. While Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) naturally handle visuo-linguistic inputs, they are often computationally intensive and opaque. We demonstrate that a pure Large Language Model (LLM), when equipped with specialized modules, can rival state-of-the-art LMMs on complex geometry problems. Our framework integrates a Geometric Vision Parser, which translates diagrams into symbolic form, with a Symbolic Solver that performs formal deductions, thereby mitigating hallucinations and promoting interpretable reasoning. To enable rigorous evaluation, we curate a benchmark of challenging problems from the 2025 Chinese Zhongkao examinations, ensuring data novelty and testing deeper deductive skills. Experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves performance comparable to Gemini 2.5 Pro while delivering clearer, human-like solutions.
summaryZh: 本文提出了一种将几何视觉解析器与符号求解器相结合的框架，使纯语言模型（LLM）能够处理复杂的平面几何问题。该方法通过将图形转化为符号逻辑进行推导，有效缓解了模型幻觉问题，并提升了推理过程的可解释性。在2025年中国中考几何题集上的测试表明，该框架性能可媲美Gemini 2.5 Pro，且生成的解题步骤更具逻辑性与人类可读性，为解决复杂推理任务提供了新思路。
